title: Advancing super-resolution microscopy with metal complexes: functional imaging agents for nanoscale visualization
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,3616-3646
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS01193G, Tutorial Review
Nur Aininie Yusoh, Martin R. Gill, Xiaohe Tian
This review highlights recent advancements in the use of metal complexes as functional imaging agents for nanoscale imaging via super-resolution microscopy.
